blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The Army’s 4th Infantry Division (4ID) installed fresh leadership for key battalions to sustain recent victories against insurgents and secure ongoing development in Northern Mindanao and Caraga regions. In separate change-of-command ceremonies at Camp Edilberto Evangelista here on Monday, Maj. Gen. Marion Angcao, 4ID commander, formally transferred authority to the new commanding officers, emphasizing the need to preserve operational momentum.
